propositions: Execution-phase re-reviews flag plan-vs-code discrepancies as false positives when the plan's directed work has already been correctly completed
A new plan-review-only binary answer `current_state_satisfies_plan_goal` must be added to the verifier model and used to veto findings during execution phase only
The veto is cohort-restricted to `registry.CODEBASE_GROUNDED` (E4/G1G2/A1/G6) and enforced deterministically in the orchestrator wrapper to prevent single-turn tool-less verification from firing it

The `execution_review` kwarg flows from orchestrator into `pass3_decide` and `pass3_over_findings`, and drops findings with `reason="veto:plan-goal-satisfied"` when execution_review=True AND answer=yes AND criteria are code-grounded
Planning-phase reviews (execution_review=False) preserve findings unchanged; answers no/insufficient/na do not trigger the veto under execution phase
The new answer field defaults to na, is excluded from GRADED_BINARY, and is absent from base and code-review models
